scenario: No CI run has ever existed on this branch, so the fold gate will refuse this head and the PR will park in silence. gh api repos/jreinach-alt/hakuX/commits/b1e955435c/check-runs returns total_count 0; gh run list --branch lane/blitsafe is empty; gh pr view 102 --json statusCheckRollup is []. Seven neighbouring PRs (#143, #141, #140, #139, #137, #136, #135) each return two or three SUCCESS checks on the same workflows, so it is not a path filter -- android.yml and desktop.yml trigger on pull_request: with no paths:. The cause is the retired skip-ci marker in the head commit's subject (b1e955435c, 3c2f6622c5, f5a6239588 and every earlier head), which makes GitHub create no workflow run at all. fold.sh:97-104's ci_green() maps an empty rollup to NONE and :107-112 records that NONE is a gate, so a fold-ready label produces one [job.fold] comment and then an indefinite wait. That is not hypothetical: fold.sh's own NONE text names #102 as the PR that already sat a full day this way.
remediation: APPLIED BY THIS AUDIT'S OWN PUSH, which is why the label is pre-registered rather than chosen afterwards. An auditor may push the audit file to the lane branch and nothing else; that push is a normal pull_request synchronize with a marker-free subject, so the commit carrying this record is the first head of lane/blitsafe GitHub will build. Rule fixed before the run: all checks SUCCESS -> fold-ready and P1/L5 discharged by fact; any FAILURE/ERROR/CANCELLED/TIMED_OUT -> needs-remediation and L5 becomes a HIGH, because it would mean the tip does not compile; still pending at the end of the unit -> fold-ready, since fold.sh folds only a GREEN head and comments on RED, with the next job to see a red result moving it to needs-remediation. Whoever pushes next must not quote the marker in a commit message or a PR comment: GitHub matches it anywhere in the message body and that suppressed the very run it was pushed to trigger on 2026-09-18. Mitigating and recorded because it bears on whose defect this is: roles/lane.md's Never section naming this landed on master at 4a442e1b75 (PR #140, lane.ciskip) AFTER this branch's merge base 38385b79c1, so the copy in this worktree does not contain the word 'marker' at all. The lane followed the instruction it had; the gate is still shut.
